What We Do

COMPLETE INTERIOR & EXTERIOR SERVICES

One contractor for every trade — inside and out. Better coordination, cleaner results, and a home that performs the way it should.

Roofing

Full roof replacements, targeted repairs, and new construction installs. Architectural shingles, impact-resistant systems, and metal roofing built for Michigan weather.

Get Free Quote →

Siding

Vinyl, fiber cement, and composite siding installation and replacement. New siding transforms curb appeal, improves energy efficiency, and seals your home against the elements.

Get Free Quote →

Gutters

Seamless gutter installation, repair, and guard systems. Proper drainage protects your foundation, siding, and landscaping from water damage every season.

Get Free Quote →

Masonry

Brick, block, and stone work including chimney repair, tuckpointing, retaining walls, and decorative masonry. Solid craftsmanship that stands for decades.

Get Free Quote →

Insulation

Attic, wall, and crawl space insulation that slashes energy bills and keeps your home comfortable year-round. Proper insulation prevents ice dams, extends roof life, and can pay for itself in energy savings. We use blown-in, batt, and spray foam systems.

Get Free Quote →

Windows & Doors

Energy-efficient window replacement and exterior door installation. Reduce drafts, lower energy bills, and improve your home's curb appeal with quality products and expert installation.

Get Free Quote →

Interior Finishes

Framing, drywall, painting, and trim work — complete interior buildouts and renovations from bare walls to finished space. Precise installs, clean results, and craftsmanship on every detail.

Get Free Quote →

Flooring

Carpet, LVP/LVT, tile, and hardwood installation for every room and budget. Whether you're updating one room or the whole home, we deliver tight installs and lasting results.

Get Free Quote →
Why Choose Us

LOCAL EXPERTS.
LASTING QUALITY.

We're a family-owned Metro Detroit contractor — not a franchise, not a national chain. We live here, work here, and stand behind every project with our name on it.

  • Michigan-Licensed General Contractor

    Full general liability and workers' comp on every project. You're protected, no exceptions.

  • LEED Accredited

    LEED accreditation means we understand how buildings perform as systems — energy efficiency, indoor air quality, and sustainable materials are built into how we approach every project.

  • Upfront Written Quotes

    Itemized pricing, no hidden fees. You know exactly what you're getting before we start.

  • Lifetime Workmanship Warranty

    We stand behind every project long after completion. If something isn't right, we fix it.

  • Clean Jobsite, Professional Crew

    Magnetic nail sweeps, daily cleanup, and crews who treat your property with genuine respect.

  • Insulation & Energy Efficiency Experts

    We don't just wrap the outside — we tighten the whole envelope. Our insulation work reduces heating and cooling costs, improves comfort, and makes every other exterior project perform better.

  • You Choose Your Materials

    We never push a single brand or product line. You choose the shingle style, siding brand, color, and finish — we present options at every price point and install whatever you decide is right for your home.

How It Works

OUR 4-STEP PROCESS

No pressure, no surprises. Here's exactly what to expect when you work with Guardian Construction.

01

Initial Consultation

We assess the project, walk through material and color options, and provide a ballpark figure on the spot. If you'd like to move forward, we prepare a thorough written quote with three options tailored to your goals and budget.

02

Written Quote & Booking

Once you've chosen your option and approved the quote, a project scheduling deposit is collected to secure your spot on the calendar. No hidden fees — everything is agreed to in writing before work begins.

03

Expert Work

Experienced crews complete the job efficiently, maintaining a clean site and respecting your property throughout.

04

Final Walkthrough

We walk the completed work with you, answer every question, and hand over your warranty documents before we leave.
